notes: The report number «1» and the honorific «رحمه الله» are left out.
«جماعة مشايخي» is an unnamed collective (rule 8); «أبي» in the first route is the compiler's father, a bare relation.
«أبيه» with a name after it (عن أبيه عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري) is the name alone (rule 7).
The two routes have no written meeting point, so there is no shared tail.
The Imam after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2).
